abstention_policy: No abstention hint and no threshold for v1 (configs/abstain.json policy "no_abstain_hint"). abstain_p is logged per pack and used only inside lenses. Pooled AUC is 0.82 (dev 0.814, dev200 0.855; r1 0.719 / 0.808). Over 45 unanswerable vs 606 answerable questions, precision peaks at about 0.29 (thr 0.5: 16 TP / 40 FP; thr 0.8: 9 TP / 22 FP). Temporal packs reach abstain_p >= 0.8 on 21 answerable questions. Real Reactor abstained correctly on 3/3 unanswerable questions without a hint and over-abstained on 1 multi question, so a hint would push the wrong way. A route gets a soft hint (never a forced abstention) only once its per-route isotonic-calibrated abstain_p reaches precision >= 0.7 at recall >= 0.4 on pooled dev+dev200. Never on temporal.
brief_a:
ROUND 3 BRIEF, role A (structure). Frozen v1: routed dev S 86.0 / Sall 84.9, dev200 84.9 / 83.2. Biggest remaining losses (gold -> route): ku->ssu (dev 25 q at S 77, dev200 9 q at S 55), multi->ssu and temporal->ssu (14 dev q at S about 50). Gold-type ssu, ssa and ku are saturated at about 93.5. Citations: Reactor cites among the passages we send, so keep passages close to the cite set (Sall = S). New harness: sweep --qfilter, --route writes to <type>-routed, per-type breakdown, passages_mean; audit --compare OLD / --diff OLD NEW (list every test pack you change).
- ssu-A: (1) Build a value-disagreement gate for KU pairs, together with ku-B. Fire only when two affirmed own statements of the same attribute head carry different values of the same type (number, time, name, model). Never fire on sibling slots (R-77 capacitor vs dial lamp) or on name drift. Report routed ssu dev/dev200 and list the test firings; today ku_pair_p fires on 6 of 45 test ssu questions: q_2ea50c2672ba, q_6e893bcca955, q_ca7af42dbd6c, q_6d1f42a4c0a8, q_f14893711b1a, q_b7053d97740b. (2) Degrade gracefully on misrouted aggregates: when the question has a count or comparison word or a time window, widen to +/-1 neighbours and up to 4 sessions. Measure on the --route ssu slice. (3) Tense fix: a plan clause outranks a past marker in 'did I / was I' questions.
- ssa-A: (1) Fit role_guess as a logistic model on dev and hold out dev200. Add your recommendation-sentence scan (partial names such as 'Brew Supply') and an impersonal-user-fact feature ('the new apartment'). Keep FP 0 on both splits and on the test list. (2) List-position questions (fifth / number 7 / last on the list): pack the assistant chunk holding the list plus the next chunk. (3) Analyse the 13 dev ssa questions still routed to ssu (S 84).
- multi-A: (1) Pinned instance sentences: sentence-level CE, own, declarative, not declined, placed ahead of depth units, so buried facts (the Sao Paulo book) get in without widening packs. (2) A multi_like(q, hx) evidence detector (two or more sessions with own instance sentences of the same category) for an ssu->multi hand-off. Measure it on the 9 dev multi->ssu questions with 0 FP on gold ssu, and print every test firing. (3) Port facet_absence into an abstain_p for b_tight and calibrate it on dev+dev200 pooled.
- ku-A: (1) CE admission of paraphrased newest values into the timeline (dev 'switched to a Ford F-150'; test long-run recap). (2) Prefer habitual or change statements ('increased my morning swim to 30 laps') over one-off events ('did 40 laps today') for 'each morning / these days' questions. (3) Per-owner totals ('neighbor Bjorn and I in total'), with relative updates ('2 more') applied to the previous value and a summed computed value.
- temporal-A: (1) Cut the no-computed gap packs. On test, 4 flagged packs get no value: trail-running shoes -> first trail run, medical check-up -> vaccines, sourdough starter -> first loaf, years served as a firefighter. Handle planned future events and 'how many years did I serve'. (2) Parse 'how many months have passed since I last X' as ago-last (the newest own mention). (3) Reschedule guard: when a pick is a scheduled date and a later own mention gives a different date, add it as runner-up. (4) Order questions: restatement mentions plus the opening user turn of each event session, in a tight pack. Your lens is used through lenses/temporal/merged_r2.py evA_mixB, so keep a_gap's VARIANTS names stable.
brief_b:
ROUND 3 BRIEF, role B (semantic). Frozen v1: routed dev S 86.0 / Sall 84.9, dev200 84.9 / 83.2. Biggest remaining losses (gold -> route): ku->ssu (dev 25 q at S 77, dev200 9 q at S 55), multi->ssu and temporal->ssu (14 dev q at S about 50). Gold-type ssu, ssa and ku are saturated at about 93.5. Citations: Reactor cites among the passages we send, so keep passages close to the cite set (Sall = S). New harness: sweep --qfilter, --route writes to <type>-routed, per-type breakdown, passages_mean; audit --compare OLD / --diff OLD NEW (list every test pack you change).
- ssu-B: (1) Merge your all-role recall sweep into a_struct2 r3rn as a recall backstop only, with no change to the cite set or the pack size on test. (2) Precompute sentence-level CE (hx.rerank_texts) for the top-12 user units, and turn abstain_p into a pool-relative z-score of the best user-unit logit. (3) Before the recency pick on drift questions, run a slot-specific lexical check (rarest slot term or abbreviation, e.g. intermediate frequency -> IF).
- ssa-B: (1) Build one combined role detector (your CE margin plus A's structural recommendation scan) behind the same role_guess(q, hx) signature in lenses/ssa/b_role.py. The route wrappers lenses/ssu/merged_r2.py and lenses/multi/merged_r2.py call it directly, so keep FP 0 on dev and dev200 and print the test firings (0 today). (2) A temporal-route hand-off with its own features (12 FP at 0.7 today), measured on 'my example of Netflix'-style questions. (3) Do not trim ssa packs further (about 2.7k chars on test; trimming loses PA).
- multi-B: (1) Adaptive breadth for windowed counts: when kind == count and the window prior is active, keep in-window sessions with p >= tk/2, up to 12. Check it with the test audit (passages per test multi pack are now 5.35). (2) Refit p(gold) with richer features (first-person numeric fact, facet-hit flags, window flag) on dev, holding out dev200. (3) Instance expansion for category questions: hx.dense_texts over the user sentences of sessions ranked 4-15. (4) Keep a variant whose passages equal the cite set exactly (Sall = S), as the fallback if Reactor turns out to cite everything.
- ku-B: (1) The value-type gate for ku_pair_p, shared with ssu-A: two own statements of the same attribute head with different values of the same type. Target the 25 dev / 9 dev200 ku->ssu questions with 0 FP on gold ssu and no firing on test sibling slots or name drift (today 6 test firings: q_2ea50c2672ba, q_6e893bcca955, q_ca7af42dbd6c, q_6d1f42a4c0a8, q_f14893711b1a, q_b7053d97740b). Report e5-style routed numbers. (2) Own-value constraint in the pair: when a pair member is someone else's value, replace it with the best own sentence of the same value type. (3) Calibrate abstain_p on dev+dev200 pooled; count the bigram signal only together with low coverage.
- temporal-B: (1) Gap fallback by agreement: when A withholds a raw value that equals B's computed value, emit it (test: Montreal lease = 45). (2) Trim the whole-question route towards its cite set (merged_r2: S 81.3 vs Sall 77.6 on dev), e.g. at most len(cite) + 1 sessions. (3) Use sentence-level hx.rerank_texts to find the second gold turn in 'first' questions (paraphrased turns). (4) For 'ago' questions that state an explicit date, compute from the question date directly. Your lens is used through lenses/temporal/merged_r2.py evA_mixB, so keep b_merge's VARIANTS names stable.
